title: Science Source Ledger
purpose: Primary and high-quality scientific/mathematical sources used to extend Tim Dooley / Potato of Life scientific comparisons, dimensional analysis, measurement, model testing, cross-scale formalization, phase dynamics and celestial-coordinate auditing without converting analogy into empirical proof.

source_quality_rule: Prefer original papers, peer-reviewed reviews, official metrology/standards sources and authoritative scientific references. Popular explanations can support pedagogy but should not outrank primary/technical material for equations or precision claims.
archive_rule: Every scientific equation placed beside Potatoverse concepts must identify whether it is Tim-originated, later archive formalization, or established external mathematics/physics. External sources support the external science only, not the spiritual claim mapped onto it.
measurement_rule: Every imported numerical value should record units, precision/uncertainty where material, source date/version and whether the value is measured, fitted, assumed, conventional or derived.
coordinate_rule: Astronomical values additionally require coordinate frame and epoch; local-horizon values require observer position and time.
